info.title: PWT API
info.description: PWT Digital Platform REST API. All endpoints return the standard envelope { success, message, data, meta?, errors?, code? }. See CLAUDE.md § 5.2 for the contract.

get.description: List the caller's addresses sorted by is_default DESC then created_at DESC. Unpaginated (max 10 per customer).

post.description: Create a new address. Setting is_default=true atomically demotes any previous default. The first address is auto-promoted to default. The 11th address is rejected with ERR_ADDRESS_LIMIT_REACHED.

get.description: Show a single owned address. Ownership failure returns 403 (not 404) per CLAUDE.md § 7.3.

delete.description: Soft-delete an owned address. If it was the default, the next-most-recent surviving address is auto-promoted (returned as promoted_default_id). Phase 8 will add the ERR_ADDRESS_IN_USE guard.

patch.description: Partial update. Setting is_default=true atomically demotes any previous default. Omitted fields are unchanged; explicit-null clears nullable fields.

get.description: Paginated activity-log readings (super_admin only). Filters: actor_id, action (alias for log_name), log_name, event, subject_type (FQN or short alias — order, machine, etc.), subject_id, date_from, date_to, search (matches description). Sorted newest first. Default 50 rows, max 200.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Alias for log_name. Wins if both supplied.

parameters.name: subject_type
parameters.description: FQN (App\Models\Order) or short alias (order, machine, maintenance_request, product, user, support_ticket, banner, promotion, testimonial, notification_template).

post.description: Authenticate an admin staff member by email + password. Rejects customers and inactive accounts with the same 401 envelope (anti-enumeration). On success returns the admin profile, an 8-hour Sanctum token (ability `admin`), the role name, the granted permission keys, and a derived capability map.
Revoke the current admin Sanctum token. Other tokens belonging to the same admin (e.g. another device or browser) are unaffected.

get.description: Returns the current admin profile, role, granted permission keys, and capability map. Used by the dashboard shell to render navigation and gate pages.
Paginated list of all categories including inactive (and optionally soft-deleted). Filters: search, is_active, parent_id, include_trashed. Sortable by display_order, name, code, created_at.

post.description: Create a new category. Bilingual name/description objects. EN is mandatory; AR optional.

get.description: Single-category detail. Soft-deleted rows are included so the dashboard can render a "deactivated" badge.

put.description: Replace the category fields. PUT semantics — every translatable field must be re-sent.

delete.description: Soft-delete the category. Blocked with 422 ERR_CATEGORY_HAS_PRODUCTS when the category still has non-trashed products. Super_admin only.

get.description: Paginated product list across all is_active states (and optionally soft-deleted). Filters: search, category_id, is_active, is_featured, is_quote_only, stock_status, term, created_from, created_to, include_trashed.

post.description: Create a product. Optionally accepts inline `prices: [...]` and `specs: [...]` arrays inserted in the same transaction. `images: [...]` is rejected — use POST /admin/products/{id}/images.

get.description: Full product detail including ALL price rows (active + inactive), specs, images, category, and counts. Soft-deleted products are returned with `deleted_at` populated.

put.description: Replace the product fields. `code` is immutable (422 ERR_PRODUCT_CODE_IMMUTABLE if present). When `prices` or `specs` are submitted, replace-all semantics apply atomically.

delete.description: Soft-delete the product. Blocked with 422 ERR_PRODUCT_HAS_ACTIVE_ORDERS when the product is referenced by an open (pending/confirmed/scheduled/out_for_delivery) order. Super_admin only.

patch.description: Thin toggle endpoint — accepts any subset of `is_active`, `is_featured`, `is_quote_only`, `stock_status`. At least one must be present. Returns full product detail.

post.description: Attach a pre-uploaded files row (type=product_image) as a product image. Idempotent on (product_id, file_id). When is_primary=true, the previous primary is atomically demoted. Returns full product detail with the refreshed images array. Status 200 (not 201) because the canonical resource being modified is the parent product.

delete.description: Hard-delete a product image row. Cross-product mismatch (image belongs to a different product) returns 404. Returns full product detail.

get.description: Paginated banners across all is_active states (incl. scheduled, expired, and trashed). Filters: search, placement, is_active, starts_before/after, ends_before/after, include_trashed.

post.description: Create a banner. Returns 201 + full detail.

get.description: Detail incl. raw bilingual JSON for translatable fields. Soft-deleted rows are visible with deleted_at populated.

put.description: Replace the banner fields. `code` is immutable post-creation and is silently dropped if supplied.

get.description: Paginated promotions across all is_active states + scheduled + expired + trashed. Filters: search, type, applies_to, is_active, status (active|upcoming|expired|inactive), starts_before/after, ends_before/after, include_trashed.

post.description: Create a promotion. `code` is uppercased + trimmed server-side. When applies_to=products|categories the matching pivot is replace-all inserted inside the same transaction.

get.description: Detail incl. raw bilingual JSON for name/description, the full applies_to pivot rows, redemption aggregates, and total_limit / per_user_limit. Soft-deleted rows visible.

put.description: Replace promotion fields. `code` is immutable and silently dropped if supplied. Pivot tables (`promotion_products` / `promotion_categories`) use replace-all semantics when applies_to / product_ids / category_ids is present.

delete.description: Soft-delete the promotion. Returns 422 ERR_PROMOTION_HAS_REDEMPTIONS when any redemption row exists — admins should deactivate via PUT is_active=false instead. Super_admin only.

get.description: Paginated testimonials across all is_active states (incl. trashed). Filters: search, is_active, rating, rating_min, rating_max, include_trashed.

post.description: Create a testimonial. Only `quote` is translatable; `name`, `role`, `company` are plain strings.

get.description: Detail incl. raw bilingual JSON for the `quote` field. Soft-deleted rows visible.

put.description: Replace testimonial fields. `quote` is merged with stored translations so a single-locale PUT does not erase the other.

get.description: KPI snapshot for the admin landing page. No filters, no pagination. Open to any admin role. Cached server-side for 60 s; meta.cached indicates whether this response was served from cache.

Paginated list across all machines. Filters: search, country_code, product_id, customer_id, needs_maintenance (with within_days lookahead), is_active, source, term, include_trashed (super_admin only). Sort: created_at|installed_at|next_maintenance_due_at|serial_number.

post.description: Create a machine for an existing customer. Source forced to `created`; order_id forced to null. If filter_change_interval_months is set without an explicit next_maintenance_due_at, the scheduler computes the next due date.

get.description: Machines whose next_maintenance_due_at is within ?within_days (default 30, max 365). Forced sort: next_maintenance_due_at ASC.
Single-machine detail including soft-deleted rows. Returns notes, latest 50 maintenance logs, latest 20 maintenance requests.

put.description: Update a machine. `user_id` and `product_id` are immutable. Recomputes next_maintenance_due_at when filter_change_interval_months changes AND no explicit override is supplied.

get.description: Paginated list across all maintenance requests. Filters: status (single or array), priority, issue_type, assigned_to_user_id (0 = unassigned), customer_id, machine_id, country_code, search, date_from/to, include_trashed (super_admin).

post.description: Submit on behalf of a customer. Admins may set high/urgent priority (no clamp). Fires MaintenanceRequestCreated event so Phase 11 notifies the customer. No media at submit — customer attaches later.

get.description: Single-request detail including internal_notes (admin-only), full status history with actor identities, media with signed URLs.

patch.description: Assign or re-assign a technician (operations admin). From `new`: transitions to `assigned`. From `assigned`: idempotent re-assignment with notes-only history row.
Generic status transition. Body status=assigned -> 409 ERR_USE_ASSIGN_ENDPOINT. Body status=completed -> 409 ERR_USE_CLOSE_ENDPOINT. Cancellation requires a `reason`.

post.description: Close an in_progress request. Writes resolution_notes, inserts a machine_maintenance_logs row (source=request), recomputes the machine next_maintenance_due_at via the scheduler.

409.description: Only in_progress requests can be closed

get.description: Paginated list across all orders. Filters: status (single or array), search (customer name/email + order public_id), date range, payment_method, country (ISO-2 code), include_trashed (super_admin/operations only). Sort: created_at|placed_at|total_amount|status, default created_at desc.

Single-order detail including soft-deleted rows. Returns items, customer, addresses, status_history (with internal admin notes), installation, and the latest payment with gateway reference (admin context).

patch.description: Transition order status. Body: status, optional note. Actor = admin. Returns 409 ERR_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION when the state machine forbids the move; 409 ERR_USE_SCHEDULE_ENDPOINT when status=scheduled is supplied (use POST /schedule-installation).

409.description: Invalid status transition / use schedule endpoint

post.description: Admin cancel — accepts pending/confirmed/scheduled/out_for_delivery source states. Body: reason (5-1000 chars). Cancel from installed/completed/cancelled returns 409.

Transition confirmed → scheduled AND upsert order_installations. Body: scheduled_for_at (future ISO-8601), optional technician_user_id (must be an active operations admin), optional installation_notes.

Write an internal admin note as a notes-only row on order_status_history (from_status === to_status, is_internal=true). Filtered out of the customer-facing timeline. Rejected on terminal orders (409 ERR_INVALID_ORDER_STATE).

get.description: Revenue + order value by date range. Filters: date_from/to, product_id, country (ISO-2), term, payment_method, bucket. Cancelled orders excluded from revenue (rows still list them).
Counts per status + paginated rows. Filters: date range, status (single or array), country, payment_method, term.
Service requests by status / priority / assigned technician / date. Counts per status + per priority + paginated rows. Includes average resolution hours for completed rows.
Registered customers + activity. Filters: registration date range, country (resolved via default address), has_orders, is_active. Buckets are grouped by (month, country).
Streamed CSV/XLSX of the chosen report. Capped at 10 000 rows; the response carries X-PWT-Export-Truncated and X-PWT-Export-Row-Count headers. Audit-logged with log name `report.export`.

Paginated list across all support tickets. Filters: search, status (single or array), category, priority, assigned_to_user_id (0 = unassigned), customer_id, date_from/to, include_trashed (super_admin). Default sort: last_message_at DESC.
Single ticket detail — FULL thread INCLUDING internal notes, attachments, status history with full actor identities, related order/machine, customer profile.

patch.description: Update status, priority, and/or assignment. Drives the state machine via SupportTicketService::transitionTo() — invalid transitions surface as 409. Body status=open is rejected (reopen is Phase 2).

post.description: Post a reply on a support ticket. is_internal=true posts an admin-only note (permitted on terminal tickets). is_internal=false on a closed/cancelled ticket returns 409 ERR_TICKET_TERMINAL. Stamps first_response_at on the first customer-visible reply.

get.description: Paginated notification templates (super_admin only). Filters: channel, key (substring), is_active. Returns BOTH locales for subject + body so the editor UI can hydrate side-by-side.

put.description: Update bilingual subject + body + is_active (super_admin only). `key`, `channel`, and `placeholders` are immutable and silently dropped if supplied. The change is audit-logged with before/after diff under log name `admin.notification_templates`.

get.description: Paginated list of all users (admins + customers). Filters: search (name/email/phone), role, is_active, include_trashed (super_admin only), created_from, created_to. Sortable by created_at, last_login_at, name, email.

parameters.name: include_trashed
parameters.description: When true, soft-deleted users are included. Requires the users.deactivate permission (super_admin).

get.description: Single-user detail. Soft-deleted rows are included so the dashboard can render a "deactivated" badge.

delete.description: Soft-deactivate the user: sets is_active=false, soft-deletes the row, revokes all the target's Sanctum tokens. Idempotent: a re-DELETE on an already-deactivated user returns 200 with the existing row. Self-deactivation and last-super-admin removal return 422.

422.description: Cannot deactivate self / last super admin

patch.description: Partial update. At least one mutable field must be present. Role changes require the caller to be super_admin (403 ERR_FORBIDDEN otherwise). Self-deactivation, self-role-change, and last-super-admin removal return 422.

post.description: Sends a 6-digit registration OTP to the supplied phone, valid 5 minutes. Always returns 200 regardless of phone existence (anti-enumeration). In non-production envs the OTP is also returned via `data.dev_otp` for development convenience.
Verifies a 6-digit registration OTP and returns a short-lived registration token (Sanctum, ability `register-only`, 15-minute TTL).

post.summary: Complete registration with a verified registration token
post.description: Completes registration using the registration token issued by /auth/verify-otp. The phone is sourced server-side from the token and CANNOT be supplied in the request body. Email is optional in MVP (deviation from comments.xlsx row 2; see docs/architecture/auth.md § 9.1).
Authenticate with phone OR email plus password. Returns the user and a 30-day Sanctum access token.
Send a passwordless login OTP to the supplied phone. Always returns 200 (anti-enumeration). In non-production envs `data.dev_otp` carries the code for development convenience.
Verify a login OTP and exchange it for a 30-day access token directly. Disabled or soft-deleted accounts always return 401 (no enumeration leak).
Revokes the current access token. Other tokens belonging to the same user are unaffected. Use DELETE /me to revoke ALL tokens.

Request a password reset via email (link) or phone (OTP). Always returns 200 with a generic message regardless of whether the identifier matches a user (anti-enumeration; deviation from comments.xlsx row 5 per architecture § 9.4).
Complete a password reset via email+token OR phone+otp. On success ALL Sanctum tokens for the user are revoked and the user must re-login.

422.description: Token / OTP invalid or validation failed

get.description: Returns all active, non-trashed categories sorted by display_order then the localized name. Unpaginated (bounded resource — see docs/architecture/catalog.md § 1.3). Rate limited at 60 requests per minute per IP.

Returns one active category with a `products_count` (count of active products in the category). Returns 404 for missing, soft-deleted, or inactive rows — inactive categories are invisible to customers (docs/architecture/catalog.md § 1.4). Rate limited at 60 requests per minute per IP.

Paginated list of active products with category, primary image, and active-currency starting price eager-loaded. Filter by `category_id`, `term`, `search`, `min_price`, `max_price`, `currency`, `featured`. Sort by `price`, `created_at`, or `name`. Default per_page=15, max=100. Rate limited at 60 requests per minute per IP.

Returns one active product with category, all images, all specs, and all active prices across currencies/terms. `promotions_count` is hardcoded to 0 until Phase 7 (Promotions) wires the real count. Returns 404 for missing, soft-deleted, or inactive rows. Rate limited at 60 requests per minute per IP.

post.description: Submit a guest contact-form / lead. Public endpoint — no Sanctum. Rate-limited at 5/min/IP. Body field `message` is NEVER echoed back in the response.
Uploads a single image (jpeg/png/webp) or PDF up to 5 MB. The file is owned by the caller and is persisted alongside its mime, size, and SHA-256 checksum. Rate limit: 30 uploads per hour per user.

delete.description: Soft-deletes an owned file. The physical artefact is purged asynchronously by a queued job.

get.description: Stream a stored file to the caller. Owners (or admins with file view permissions) may call directly with a Sanctum bearer token; anyone holding a valid signed URL may also call. Public files may also be served via this endpoint for a uniform URL pattern.
Returns a simple envelope confirming the API is running. Used by load balancers, agents, and the verification pipeline.
List the authenticated customer's maintenance requests. Filters: status, date_from, date_to. Sorted by created_at DESC by default.

post.description: Submit a maintenance request against an owned, active machine. The customer-supplied priority is silently capped at medium (admin elevates via Phase 18). Up to 5 maintenance_media file ids may be attached. Rate-limited at 10/min/user.

get.description: Show a single maintenance request. Includes machine summary, media (signed URLs), full status history, and (conditionally) resolution_notes / cancellation_reason.

post.description: Cancel a maintenance request you submitted. Allowed only when the current status is `new`; otherwise 409 ERR_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION.

get.description: List the authenticated customer's installed machines. Filters: search, needs_maintenance, country_code, is_active. Paginated (default 15, max 100). Sort by installed_at, next_maintenance_due_at, created_at, or serial_number.
Show a single machine owned by the caller. Includes the latest 50 maintenance logs and aggregate counts. Ownership failure returns 403.

List the authenticated customer's notifications. Filters: unread_only, type, date_from, date_to. Sorted by created_at DESC. Paginated (default 15, max 100). The response `meta.unread_count` field carries the global unread total across all pages.

patch.description: Mark a single notification as read. Idempotent — re-marking an already-read row preserves the existing read_at and returns 200. Ownership-scoped: 403 on foreign id (per CLAUDE.md § 7.3).

post.description: Mark every unread notification belonging to the authenticated user as read. Returns the number of rows updated in meta.updated_count.

get.description: List the caller's orders. Filters: status, date_from, date_to. Sorted by created_at DESC. Paginated (default 15, max 100).

post.description: Place a new order from a cart. Server recomputes every monetary field; client-supplied totals or unit_price are rejected with 422. Idempotent via the optional Idempotency-Key header (24h replay window). Rate-limited at 5 requests/minute/user.

get.description: Show a single order. Returns the full detail shape: items, status_history, delivery_address, billing_address, promotion. Ownership failure returns 403 (not 404) per CLAUDE.md § 7.3.

post.description: Cancel a pending or confirmed order. Allowed status: pending, confirmed. Otherwise 409 ERR_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION. Paid orders surface a follow-up refund message — actual refund is admin-manual in MVP. Rate-limited at 10/min/user.

get.description: Tracking projection: status, progress %, next step, estimated delivery window, full timeline. Ownership-scoped; 403 on mismatch.

post.description: Initiate a payment for an owned, payable order. For online methods (card / apple_pay / google_pay) the server returns a hosted-checkout URL plus a payment_id; the customer completes payment off-site and the gateway fires the webhook. For COD the server creates a Payment row in `captured`, auto-confirms the order, and returns the resulting state. Idempotent via the optional Idempotency-Key header (24h replay window). Rate-limited at 5 requests/minute per user+IP.

Gateway → backend callback. Auth is the HMAC signature verified by middleware (X-Stub-Signature for stub; X-Payfort-Signature for PayFort). Idempotent on gateway_transaction_id — duplicate deliveries record a payment_events row but do not re-mutate Payment or Order. Always 200 on a valid signature, even for replays, so the gateway stops retrying.

get.description: Returns the status snapshot for an owned Payment. Never exposes gateway_transaction_id, gateway_reference, or the checkout URL — those are not safe to leak to a potentially-compromised customer device.

List active banners visible to customers. Optional `?placement=hero|promo|sidebar|footer` filter. Sorted by display_order then id. Unpaginated — bounded resource (≤ ~20 rows total). Rate limited at 60 requests per minute per IP.

List currently-active promotions visible to customers. Filtered server-side to `is_active=true` AND inside the active window. Sorted by `starts_at DESC, id DESC`. Unpaginated — bounded resource. Sensitive admin-only fields (`total_limit`, `per_user_limit`) are masked. Rate limited at 60 requests per minute per IP.

post.description: Validate a promo code against an order context. **Always returns HTTP 200** for promo-rule failures, with `data.valid=false` and a `reason_code` describing why (Stripe-style soft-fail — see docs/architecture/promotions.md § 5.1). HTTP 4xx is reserved for auth / validation / rate-limit failures. This endpoint is purely read-only — it does NOT reserve or redeem the code (Phase 8 writes the redemption row inside the order-creation transaction). Rate limited at 10 requests per minute per authenticated user to defeat brute-force code enumeration.

200.description: OK — `data.valid` is true on a match, false with `reason_code` on a soft-fail

get.description: List published testimonials. Sorted by display_order then id. Unpaginated — bounded resource. Only `quote` is translated to the active locale; `role` and `company` are plain strings in Phase 7. Rate limited at 60 requests per minute per IP.
Returns the 6 active GCC countries supported by PWT, with bilingual names resolved to the locale carried by the `Accept-Language` header.
Returns active regions / emirates / governorates for the given country. The `{code}` parameter is the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, case-insensitive (normalised server-side to lowercase).
Returns the whitelisted public application settings (locales, currencies, VAT rates, contact, social links, support hours). All other settings keys remain server-only.
List the authenticated customer's support tickets. Filters: status, category. Sorted by last_message_at DESC.

post.description: Submit a support ticket. Optional cross-links to an owned order or machine. Up to 5 support_attachment file ids may be attached. Rate-limited at 10/min/user.

get.description: Show a single support ticket with full message thread (internal notes excluded), attachments, related order/machine summary, and status history.

post.description: Cancel a support ticket you submitted. Allowed only when the current status is `open`; otherwise 409 ERR_INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION.

get.description: Returns the authenticated customer profile (self-only). The token already binds the user — no path parameter is accepted.

delete.description: Soft-delete the authenticated account. Requires the current password AND `confirm: "DELETE"` literal. Revokes ALL tokens for the user; the account remains restorable by a super_admin.

patch.description: Partial update of the authenticated profile. Changing `email` requires `current_password`. Changing `phone` is currently rejected with 409 ERR_PHONE_CHANGE_NOT_SUPPORTED — the full re-verify flow is deferred to Phase 13.

id.description: Stable cross-module identifier (used as orders.delivery_address_id from Phase 8).

AddressCollectionResponse.description: Unpaginated list of the caller's addresses, sorted by is_default DESC then created_at DESC (max 10 per customer).

promoted_default_id.description: Id of the address auto-promoted to default when the deleted row was the previous default; null otherwise.

StoreAddressRequest.description: Create a new address. `is_default=true` atomically demotes any previous default. The 11th address per customer is rejected with 422 ERR_ADDRESS_LIMIT_REACHED.

region_id.description: Optional; if provided, must belong to country_id.

recipient_phone.description: Local number (combined with recipient_phone_country_code) or E.164.

UpdateAddressRequest.description: Partial update; every field is optional. Omitted fields are unchanged. Explicit-null clears nullable fields (line2, region_id, area, postal_code, notes, latitude, longitude).

AdminCapabilities.description: Fixed-shape capability map keyed by permission domain. Every domain and action is always present; values are booleans indicating whether the admin holds the underlying permission key. Stable shape regardless of role.

remember.description: Reserved for a future long-lived dashboard session; ignored in MVP.

id.description:
Admin shape for a Category row. Used both as the list item and the
single-resource detail body.

Bilingual fields (`name`, `description`) are returned as raw objects
`{ "en": "...", "ar": "..." }` so the dashboard form can hydrate both
locales without a second request.

Documentation-only.

success.description:
200 / 201 OK envelope for the single-category endpoints.

Documentation-only.

200 OK paginated envelope for GET /api/v1/admin/categories.

Documentation-only.

id.description:
Full admin shape for a Product row — used both as the list item and
the single-resource detail body.

Raw bilingual JSON for every translatable field so the admin form can
hydrate both locales in one fetch.

Documentation-only.

orders_count.description: Count of non-terminal orders referencing this product.

success.description:
200 / 201 OK envelope for the single-product endpoints.

Documentation-only.

id.description:
Admin shape for a product image row.

Documentation-only.

success.description:
200 OK paginated envelope for GET /api/v1/admin/products.

Documentation-only.

id.description:
Admin shape for a price row (exposes is_active + timestamps).

Documentation-only.

Admin shape for a product spec row — raw bilingual `label` / `value`.

Documentation-only.

file_id.description:
Request body for POST /api/v1/admin/products/{product}/images.

`file_id` must reference a non-trashed files row of type
`product_image`. Ownership is intentionally NOT checked (any admin
with products.manage-images can use any product_image — see
docs/architecture/admin-catalog.md § 9.3).

Documentation-only.

is_primary.description: When true, the previous primary is atomically demoted inside the same transaction.

code.description:
Request body for POST /api/v1/admin/products.

`prices` and `specs` are optional inline arrays — if provided, they
are inserted alongside the product in the same transaction (Phase 16
§ 4.3 / § 3.5.1).

Documentation-only.

prices.description: Replace-all semantics: if omitted, no prices are touched. If sent as an empty array, all prices are removed (product must be quote-only).

code.description:
Request body for PUT /api/v1/admin/categories/{category}.

PUT semantics — every translatable field must be re-sent (AR locale
falls back to the existing stored value when omitted).

Documentation-only.

category_id.description:
Request body for PUT /api/v1/admin/products/{product}.

`code` is `prohibited` — the SKU is immutable post-creation.

`prices` and `specs` use replace-all semantics: present → all existing
rows for the product are deleted and the submitted rows inserted in a
single transaction. Absent → existing rows untouched. Empty array →
all rows cleared (the product must be quote-only).

Documentation-only.

is_active.description:
Request body for PATCH /api/v1/admin/products/{product}/status.

At least one field must be present.

Documentation-only.

id.description:
Admin shape for a Banner row — used both as list item and single detail.

Documentation-only.

success.description:
200 OK paginated envelope for GET /api/v1/admin/banners.

Documentation-only.

200 / 201 OK envelope for single-banner admin endpoints.

Documentation-only.

id.description:
Admin list shape for a Promotion row (lighter — no products / categories
eager-load on list endpoint to keep N+1 contained).

Documentation-only.

Embedded category reference on AdminPromotionDetail.categories[*].

Documentation-only.

success.description:
200 OK paginated envelope for GET /api/v1/admin/promotions.

Documentation-only.

id.description:
Embedded product reference on AdminPromotionDetail.products[*].

Documentation-only.

success.description:
200 / 201 OK envelope for single-promotion admin endpoints.

Documentation-only.

id.description:
Admin shape for a Testimonial row — used both as list item and single
detail.

Documentation-only.

success.description:
200 OK paginated envelope for GET /api/v1/admin/testimonials.

Documentation-only.

200 / 201 OK envelope for single-testimonial admin endpoints.

Documentation-only.

max_discount_amount.description: Required when type=percent; forbidden when type=fixed.

placement.description:
Request body for PUT /api/v1/admin/banners/{banner}.

`code` is immutable post-creation and silently dropped server-side.

Documentation-only.

en.description:
Request body for PUT /api/v1/admin/promotions/{promotion}.

`code` is immutable post-creation and silently dropped server-side.

Documentation-only.

user_id.description: Owning customer id; must hold the customer role.

next_maintenance_due_at.description: Optional explicit override; requires filter_change_interval_months to be set.

UpdateMachineRequest.description: All fields optional. `user_id` and `product_id` are immutable.

next_maintenance_due_at.description: Explicit override; when supplied, bypasses scheduler auto-recompute.

description_excerpt.example: The water flow has been slow for the last week…

assigned_to_user_id.description: Active admin in the operations role.

completed_at.description: Defaults to today; must be on/before today and on/after the machine installed_at and request created_at.

machine_id.description: Must belong to customer_id and be active.

internal_notes.description: Admin-only; never returned on customer surface.

UpdateAdminMaintenanceStatusRequest.description: `assigned` -> use PATCH /assign; `completed` -> use POST /close (both return 409 here).

note.example: Spoke with customer; they will be home Friday between 10am-2pm

id.description:
Customer summary embedded inside AdminOrderDetail.

Documentation-only.

technician_user_id.description: Must reference an active user with the operations role (MVP); the dedicated technician role lands in Phase 2.

tags.name: Reference
tags.description: Public lookup data: countries, regions and whitelisted application settings.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Customer authentication: OTP registration, login, password reset, logout.

tags.name: Addresses
tags.description: Customer address book for delivery destinations. Each address belongs to one customer and is scoped by ownership.

tags.name: Catalog
tags.description: Public read-only catalog of categories, products, images, specs, and prices. Inactive resources are filtered out of customer responses.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Customer order placement, history, tracking, and cancellation. All monetary fields are recomputed server-side; idempotent on the optional Idempotency-Key header.

tags.name: Machines
tags.description: Customer-owned installed filter units. Read-only for customers; admin Phase 18 manages create/edit. Includes maintenance logs and next-due date.

tags.name: Maintenance
tags.description: Customer maintenance requests against owned machines. Submit, list, view, and cancel-from-new. Admin assign/progress/complete lives in Phase 18.

tags.name: Support
tags.description: Authenticated customer support tickets — create, list, view thread, cancel. Internal admin notes are never returned to customers. Admin assign/reply lives in Phase 19.

tags.name: Contact
tags.description: Public guest contact-form / lead capture. No authentication. Rate-limited at 5/min/IP. The submitted `message` is never echoed back in the response.

tags.name: Admin / Users
tags.description: Admin lifecycle management for both admin and customer accounts: list, detail, partial update (incl. role + activation), soft-deactivate. super_admin gates writes; support has read-only access.

tags.name: Admin / Orders
tags.description: Admin operations against the customer orders aggregate: list, detail, status transitions, expanded-window cancel, schedule installations, internal notes. Reuses the Phase 8 state machine.

tags.name: Admin / Reports
tags.description: Admin reporting & export endpoints — read-only analytics (sales / orders / maintenance / customers) and streamed CSV/XLSX downloads. Capped at 10,000 rows per export with truncation header.
